description: Address code review issues: fix SHAP chart rendering, What-If deterministic fallback, batch prediction schema mapping, role guards, dark mode coverage, and advisor history validation.
steps: Fix predictions.js: change response.explanation check to response.features, and use item.contribution instead of item.shap_value for bar magnitude
Fix what_if.php: replace rand(3,12) with deterministic fixed offset (e.g., max(5, $new_probability - 8))

Fix batch_predict.php: transform each student record field names before forwarding to AI backend (nilai_rata_rata -> scores dict, peringkat -> school_ranking, total_siswa -> total_students, akreditasi -> school_accreditation, target_prodi -> target_program_id)
Fix batch_prediction.php: add role guard requiring guru role
Fix metrics.php: add role guard requiring admin role (soft check for demo)
Fix style.css dark-mode: add overrides for shadow-sm, shadow-md, shadow-lg, shadow-xl, color-accent-blue-light, color-primary-light, plus form inputs and cards
Fix predictions.js SHAP canvas: detect dark mode and adjust text fill color accordingly
Fix advisor.php: add validation for history array (max 20 entries, each must have role and content string fields)
acceptance_criteria: SHAP chart renders correctly using response.features and item.contribution
What-If fallback produces deterministic results with fixed offset
Batch prediction PHP proxy transforms field names before forwarding to AI backend
Dark mode covers shadow variables, accent colors, and form inputs
SHAP canvas text adapts to dark mode
verification: php -l website/api/what_if.php && php -l website/api/batch_predict.php && php -l website/api/advisor.php && php -l website/pages/batch_prediction.php && php -l website/pages/metrics.php
